```{=html}
<style>
  #title-block-header { display: none; }
  #home-d { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 1.18rem; }
  #home-d .grid { row-gap: 1.25rem; }
  /* compact hero: logo + tagline + intro, no buttons (they live in the navbar) */
  #home-d .hero { text-align: center; padding: 0 1rem .25rem; }
  #home-d .hero img { max-height: 100px; width: auto; max-width: 100%; }
  #home-d .hero .tagline { font-size: 1.45rem; color: #1b4f72; margin: .35rem 0 .3rem; font-weight: 500; }
  #home-d .hero .lead-text { font-size: 1.05em; color: #444; max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; }
  #home-d h2 { border: 0; font-size: 1.6rem; margin: .6rem 0 .5rem; }
  /* "What we do": 2x2 cards, icon left of text */
  #home-d .features { row-gap: .75rem; column-gap: .75rem; }
  #home-d .feature { border: 1px solid #e3ebf1; border-radius: 8px; padding: .55rem 1rem; height: 100%; background: #fff; }
  #home-d .feature p { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .9rem; line-height: 1.35; }
  #home-d .feature i { font-size: 1.7rem; color: #5a9bbf; flex: none; }
  #home-d .philosophy { background: #f4f8fb; border-left: 4px solid #1b4f72; padding: .75rem 1.25rem;
    margin: .8rem 0 0; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; }
  #home-d .philosophy h3 { margin: 0 0 .35rem; font-size: 1.3rem; color: #1b4f72; }
  #home-d .philosophy p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.4; }
  /* news band (as in variant C), full height of the row */
  #home-d .news-panel { background: #e8f1f7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; height: 100%; }
  #home-d .news-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 .4rem; font-size: 1.45rem; color: #1b4f72; }
  #home-d #listing-recent-posts { margin-right: 0; }
  #home-d #listing-recent-posts .quarto-post { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr; grid-template-areas: none;
    column-gap: .8rem; row-gap: .1rem; padding: .55rem 0; margin: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfdfea; }
  #home-d #listing-recent-posts .quarto-post:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  #home-d #listing-recent-posts .thumbnail { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 2; margin: 0; }
  #home-d #listing-recent-posts .thumbnail img { width: 64px; height: 64px !important; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; }
  #home-d #listing-recent-posts .body { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
  #home-d #listing-recent-posts .metadata { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; display: block; text-align: left; }
  #home-d #listing-recent-posts .listing-title { font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; font-weight: 500; }
  #home-d #listing-recent-posts .listing-date { font-size: .9rem; color: #5b6b78; }
  #home-d .all-posts { display: block; text-align: right; margin-top: .4rem; font-size: 1rem; }
  /* Dark mode (light/dark toggle) */
  body.quarto-dark #home-d .hero .tagline,
  body.quarto-dark #home-d .philosophy h3,
  body.quarto-dark #home-d .news-panel h2 { color: #5dade2; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-d .hero .lead-text { color: #ced4da; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-d .feature { background: #2b3035; border-color: #495057; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-d .philosophy { background: #26323c; border-left-color: #5dade2; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-d .news-panel { background: #26323c; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-d #listing-recent-posts .quarto-post { border-bottom-color: #3d4b57; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-d #listing-recent-posts .quarto-post:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-d #listing-recent-posts .listing-date { color: #adb5bd; }
</style>
```

## What we do

::::{.grid .features}
:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .feature}
<i class="bi bi-clipboard2-pulse"></i> We develop open tools for neuropsychological assessment and rehabilitation

<i class="bi bi-activity"></i> We study brain functions and biomarkers using MEEG
:::
:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .feature}
<i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i> We create open-source pipelines for neural data analysis
:::
:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .feature}
<i class="bi bi-graph-up"></i> We develop/optimize methods for behavioural and brain data analysis
:::

::::{.philosophy}
### Lab philosophy

The Lab philosophy is focused on rigour and **Open Science** principles. We are committed to sharing our code, methods, data, results but also teaching materials and educational resources to the scientific community, to promote transparency, reproducibility and collaboration in research.
